items.title: Gold heads for steep weekly loss as Hormuz tensions lift crude toward five-month highs
items.summary: Spot gold fell 2.40% to about $4,026.56 on 23 October, heading for a weekly loss of more than 3.5%. Renewed Strait of Hormuz and US-Iran tensions pushed oil higher and strengthened expectations of tight Fed policy, with traders pricing about a 78% chance of another hike by December.

items.title: FDA proposes cadmium action levels for baby food under Closer to Zero
items.summary: The US FDA proposed draft, nonbinding cadmium limits for processed foods for children under 2: 10 ppb for most fruits, vegetables and mixtures, 25 ppb for single-ingredient carrots and meats, and 45 ppb for dry infant cereals. The FDA estimates 93% of fruit, vegetable and mixture samples already meet them.

items.title: Study finds AI-generated code fails to boost productivity due to downstream bottlenecks
items.summary: A Harvard study of 718 firms found AI coding agents raised lines of code by 30% and pull requests by 23%, but with no significant rise in resolved Jira issues. Review work grew instead: PR review time rose 49% and the share of PRs needing changes doubled.

items.title: Donating Agent Skills to the Agentic AI Foundation
items.summary: Anthropic is donating its Agent Skills standard to the Linux Foundation's Agentic AI Foundation, which already hosts the Model Context Protocol, to keep it open and vendor-neutral. The foundation was co-founded by Anthropic, Block and OpenAI in 2025.
